pattern.description: Regular-expression pattern to search for by default; use literal=true to treat it as exact text.

path.description: Absolute path on the target daemon's file system of the directory or file to search. Relative paths are rejected; results and errors are reported as absolute paths.

include.description: Optional file filter glob such as `**/*.ts`.

literal.description: Treat the pattern literally instead of as a regular expression. Defaults to false.

multiline.description: Allow a match to span multiple lines. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Positive maximum number of matches to return. Defaults to 100.

timeout_seconds.description: Positive search timeout in seconds. Defaults to 60 (1 minute).
